pools.ruling: The chair's ruling R10: a COMPOSED line whose named items each carry their atom; the eight subset variants are written out as declared lines (needs = named items, excludes = omitted items) so every birth has exactly one. Chrome-adjacent, asserts no calm: stays out of the inverse default.

composed.template: Ordinary life here in prose: dawn, {items}.
composed.join: ", " in the order market, tavern, watch; only items whose atom holds
composed.dawn: colour (no atom); printed only when at least one item is named

fallback.why: R10: with none of the three, the bare line alone

pools.readerNote: reader:daily-life-placeholder (readerBattery.js:490) convicts the current fixed line on [no-market] (hasMarketInstitution, a Periodic market counts) or [no-watch] (WATCH_HOUSE /watch|guard|garrison/ over house names). The `watch` atom reads factsOf.defence.watch (watch ONLY), so a garrison-only place drops "the watch" here though the reader would pass it; and the reader never checks the tavern. Once the line is composed, the reader's PLACEHOLDER substring ("dawn, the market, the tavern, the watch") only matches the full variant — the reader must be re-keyed to the composed items in Phase B.

keyGuarantees: local mode buildLocalDailyLifeNarrative; branch on ctx.foodDeficit / foodSurplus (economicViability.metrics.foodBalance), DailyLifeTab.jsx:291-297
pools.ruling: Opted in: renders under crisis and [deficit>0] asserts adequacy, [else] asserts an ordinary supply — a famine or the hunger family (siege) contradicts them. T lookup on a band: an excluded branch has no line, so twins.

lines.text: bread is dear and the poorest households plan every meal carefully
food is adequate for most families, though prices are watched closely
granaries and kitchen gardens give the town a little breathing room
the food supply is ordinary, practical, and never taken for granted

twins.text: food is short for most families, and prices are watched closely
the food supply holds for now, and nobody takes it for granted
twins.why: no-deficit branch under a hunger-family crisis

twins.text: stores and kitchen gardens give the place a little breathing room
twins.why: surplus branch without a granary (and without the tier word)

pools.ruling: Opted in: [>=70] asserts safety after dark, which threat or unrest contradicts; the safety score is a STOP (no reader) so only the crisis is declared.

lines.text: people move after dusk with confidence
doors are barred early and strangers are studied before they are welcomed
ordinary errands carry a careful awareness of who controls the street

twins.text: people still move after dusk, though fewer of them and never alone
twins.why: high safety score under threat or unrest

lines.text: The talk of the day keeps returning to {stresses}.
The place is not peaceful so much as practiced: people know its routines and work around its frictions.

keyGuarantees: local mode only (isConfigured false): the four joined paragraphs, DailyLifeTab.jsx:314-319; slots are declared in their own pools above
pools.ruling: Opted in: [2][stability>=45] asserts settled authority, which a succession-family crisis contradicts. Paragraph [1] names priests and guards on every page.

lines.text: Morning starts around {anchors}. {terrain} and {trade} shape the pace: carts, tools, and gossip move where the ground and roads allow, while {culture} gives even routine bargains a recognizable local rhythm.

{food}. Work is divided by habit more than proclamation. Farmers, haulers, priests, guards, and tradespeople all know which shortages can be endured and which ones will turn into arguments before sundown.
lines.note: CENSUS-2e: the guards stop declared as guardPresence (one atom: any watch / garrison / militia). CENSUS-2g unit 3 (the chair's answer 3, block j): the priests declare priest (a senior cleric among the named people), carried through textOf until the site is wired; no reword.

lines.text: Power is felt through {govFaction | "whoever can make orders stick this week"}. Promises are weighed carefully because yesterday's bargain may not survive tomorrow. {order}.
Power is felt through {govFaction | "whoever can make orders stick this week"}. Most residents know where authority lives and how to petition it without making themselves memorable. {order}.
lines.note: "Most residents know where authority lives" is false while the seat is open

lines.text: {stress} By evening, daily life narrows to lamplight, shared meals, debts remembered, and news carried from door to door. The settlement feels less like a map marker than a set of bargains people keep renewing because leaving would cost more than staying.

twins.text: {food}. Work is divided by habit more than proclamation. Farmers, haulers, and tradespeople all know which shortages can be endured and which ones will turn into arguments before sundown.
twins.why: paragraph [1] for a place with no watch, garrison or militia (drops priests and guards)

twins.text: Power is felt through {govFaction | "whoever can make orders stick this week"}. Most residents know who held authority last, and are waiting to learn who holds it next. {order}.
